Hearts for Hope

Hearts for Hope Gala 2024 — An Evening to Change Lives

Join friends and neighbors for an unforgettable night of dinner, music, and giving — all to support children and families in our community.

  • Date: Saturday, October 19, 2024
  • Time: 6:00 PM – 10:30 PM
  • Location: Fairview Community Hall, Fairview, OH
  • Tickets: From $75 per guest
RSVP Now

About the Gala

For twelve years, the Hearts for Hope Gala has brought our community together for one purpose: giving every local child a safe place to learn, grow, and dream. This year's gala will raise funds for after-school tutoring, emergency family assistance, and our free summer meals program.

Every ticket purchased and every dollar raised stays right here in Fairview and the surrounding neighborhoods. Last year, with your help, we served over 1,200 families. This year, we hope to do even more — and we can't do it without you.

Date & Location

When

Saturday, October 19, 2024
Doors open at 6:00 PM
Program begins at 7:00 PM
Dancing until 10:30 PM

Where

Fairview Community Hall
128 Maple Ridge Road
Fairview, OH 44126

Free parking is available on-site, with accessible entrances on the east side of the building.

Fairview Community Hall is a short walk from the Maple Ridge trolley stop and offers a large lot for guests arriving by car.

Schedule of the Evening

  1. 6:00 PM — Welcome reception, cocktails & silent auction opens
  2. 7:00 PM — Dinner is served
  3. 7:45 PM — Opening remarks & stories of impact
  4. 8:15 PM — Live auction & fund-a-need appeal
  5. 9:00 PM — Live music with The Fairview Quartet
  6. 10:30 PM — Evening concludes, winners of silent auction announced

Our Impact

1,200+

families served through tutoring and meal programs last year

$184,000

raised at last year's gala for emergency family assistance

350

volunteer hours donated by our Fairview neighbors

"Hearts for Hope helped my daughter get the tutoring she needed to stay in school. This gala, and the people behind it, changed our lives."

— Maria Chen, program participant

Our Sponsors

We're deeply grateful to the local businesses who make this evening possible.

Maple Ridge Bank

Fairview Family Dental

Greenway Landscaping

RSVP

Please reserve your seat by October 5, 2024. We can't wait to celebrate with you!

Ticket type

Frequently Asked Questions

Is there a dress code?

Cocktail attire is recommended, though all are welcome exactly as they are.

Can I buy tickets at the door?

We recommend RSVPing in advance, as the gala typically sells out. A limited number of tickets may be available at the door, subject to space.

Are children welcome?

This is an adults-focused evening event, but we offer family-friendly events throughout the year. Contact us for details.

Is my ticket purchase tax-deductible?

A portion of each ticket is tax-deductible. You will receive a donation receipt by email after the event for your records.

Who can I contact with questions?

Reach our events team at events@heartsforhope.org or call (440) 555-0192.

Hearts for Hope Foundation

128 Maple Ridge Road, Fairview, OH 44126 · (440) 555-0192 · events@heartsforhope.org

© 2024 Hearts for Hope Foundation. All rights reserved.
